name: Google SERP API
description: Google SERP API for Python and the command line: organic results with the AI Overview, news, images, local places, autocomplete and Google Trends as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no Google API key or proxies needed.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Google organic results, AI Overview and related searches
commands.description: Google web results for a query: organic results with rank, title, link, snippet and date, plus the AI Overview, related searches and pagination when Google shows them.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to search, e.g. "best usb c hub for macbook".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: UI language, e.g. `en`, `it`.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Search from this place, e.g. "Milan, Italy": the results a searcher there sees.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Desktop or mobile results page.

inputs.name: num
inputs.description: How many organic results to collect, 1 to 100; Google serves about 10 per page and the pages are merged.

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: Result page, 1-based.

inputs.name: safe
inputs.description: SafeSearch.

commands.name: news
commands.help: Google News articles for a topic
commands.description: Google News results for a query: title, publisher, how long ago, snippet and link.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Topic to search in Google News, e.g. "electric vehicles".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: UI language, e.g. `en`, `it`.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Search from this place, e.g. "Milan, Italy": the results a searcher there sees.

inputs.name: num
inputs.description: Results to request (clamped to 1–100 by the service; Google serves ~10 per page and merges pages — see `search_metadata.paging`).

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: Result page, 1-based.

commands.name: images
commands.help: Google Images results for a query
commands.description: Google Images results for a query: thumbnail, the page that uses the image and its host.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to search in Google Images.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: UI language, e.g. `en`, `it`.

inputs.name: num
inputs.description: Results to request (clamped to 1–100 by the service; Google serves ~10 per page and merges pages — see `search_metadata.paging`).

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: Result page, 1-based.

inputs.name: safe
inputs.description: SafeSearch.

commands.name: places
commands.help: local businesses from Google's local results
commands.description: Local results for a query in a place: name, rating, review count, category, address, phone, website, coordinates, opening hours and the place id.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Business type or name, e.g. "coffee shop"; set the place with --location.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Where to search, as a place name, e.g. "Austin, Texas, United States".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: UI language, e.g. `en`, `it`.

inputs.name: num
inputs.description: Results to request (clamped to 1–100 by the service; Google serves ~10 per page and merges pages — see `search_metadata.paging`).

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: Result page, 1-based.

inputs.name: gps_coordinates
inputs.description: `maps`/`places`: map center `lat,lon[,zoom]`. Wins over `uule` and `location`.

commands.name: autocomplete
commands.help: Google autocomplete suggestions for a seed
commands.description: The suggestions Google offers while typing a seed query, with Google's own relevance score: real searches people make, for keyword research.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Seed query whose suggestions you want, e.g. "google serp".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: UI language, e.g. `en`, `it`.

commands.name: trends
commands.help: Google Trends interest over time and related queries
commands.description: Google Trends for a keyword: interest over time for the last 12 months (0 to 100), plus the top and rising related queries in the full response.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Keyword to read in Google Trends, e.g. "air fryer".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: UI language, e.g. `en`, `it`.
